title: Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities
abstract: arXiv:2608.29209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we examine how well AI-generated multimodal stories align with the lived practices, relationships, language, values, and visual expectations of the communities they represent. We conduct a community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, combining quantitative annotations with qualitative focus group discussions. We find that cultural alignment depends not simply on recognizable cultural markers, but on how those markers fit social, linguistic, procedural, and visual context. From these evaluations, we develop a taxonomy of cultural alignment comprising five broader cultural marker categories and eight recurring mechanisms of misalignment. We additionally evaluate five multimodal LLM judges to examine whether automated evaluation can approximate community-grounded judgments at scale. translated_title: 迈向文化对齐：针对五个非洲社区的多模态AI故事以人为本评估
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们研究了AI生成的多模态故事与其所代表的社区的生活实践、人际关系、语言、价值观和视觉期望的契合程度。我们对来自五个非洲社区的19名文化代表开展了基于社区的混合方法评估，将定量标注与定性焦点小组讨论相结合。我们发现，文化对齐并不仅仅取决于可识别的文化标记，而是取决于这些标记如何契合社会、语言、程序和视觉语境。基于这些评估，我们构建了一个文化对齐分类体系，涵盖五大文化标记类别和八种反复出现的失对齐机制。此外，我们还评估了五个多模态大语言模型评判器，以检验自动化评估能否大规模地近似基于社区的判断。评判器的可靠性与评分校准在不同社区之间存在显著差异。
tldr: 该研究通过五个非洲社区19名文化代表的混合方法评估，揭示了AI多模态故事的文化对齐取决于文化标记与社会、语言、程序及视觉语境的契合度，提出了包含五大文化标记类别和八种失对齐机制的文化对齐分类体系，并发现多模态LLM自动评判器在不同社区间的可靠性差异显著。
en_tdlr: Through community-grounded mixed-methods evaluations with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, this paper develops a taxonomy of cultural alignment for AI-generated multimodal stories—comprising five cultural marker categories and eight recurring misalignment mechanisms—and shows that multimodal LLM judges vary substantially in reliability and score calibration across communities.
